VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The only evidence is the agent's self-report (provenance class SELF), with no independent artifacts (CI log, diff, test output). Self-attestation alone is insufficient to verify the acceptance criteria. Additionally, the described fix—cache TTL sweep and write-through invalidation—is suspicious: rounding drift in netting is typically an arithmetic/accumulation issue, not a cache eviction problem, raising doubt the actual root cause was addressed.
